output.explanation: Expanded runner downward into runner-attempt and runner-publisher: the central diagram retains service-owned helpers and per-call policy, while the peripherals expose scoped execution resources and nested publication state. Left core, state, requests, location and execution unchanged. Checked the pinned checkout's instance graph, execution borrowing, runner, step, publisher, retry and captured tool execution. Clarified source-backed boundaries: the activation gate wraps executeTool in the runner; the publisher records provider finish/usage, while attempt settlement publishes Step.Ended; fragment timer handles belong to publisher state but their fibers are children of the provider fiber. Preserved all existing edges, moving endpoints only where their concepts moved, and added containment and interaction edges. New diagrams fit below the runner without moving existing diagrams.

Durable state and admission: host-shared services
[bus.ts; database/database.ts; session/{store,inbox,projector,sql}.ts]
|
|-- Database.Service: SQLite
|   |-- Event sequence rows; optional retained event payloads [event/sql.ts]
|   |-- Session/message/part/inbox rows + execution claim fields [session/sql.ts]
|   `-- Job, schedule, instruction and saved-policy records
|-- Bus: publication and observation boundary
|   |-- Durable publish/publishAll transaction
|   |   |-- Run registered projectors + local commit hook; advance sequence
|   |   `-- Retain event payload only when configured with persist: true
|   |-- Post-commit notification -> live subscribers
|   |-- log(after, follow): retained history -> Synced watermark -> DB-backed tail
|   |   `-- Payload replay/tail requires retention; default persist is false
|   `-- subscribe is volatile; replay applies serialized durable events
|-- SessionProjector: registers handlers with Bus (not owned by Bus)
|   |-- Message materialization helpers: SessionMessageUpdater + SessionStored
|   |   `-- -> message/part tables; optional SessionBlob media storage
|   `-- Inbox delivery, forks, lifecycle, compaction, costs and token usage -> rows
|-- SessionStore: indexed session/message reads, pagination and active context
|   |-- Reads -> SQLite; decodes stored messages and media references
|   `-- Started -> claim; terminal -> release; restart -> countResume
|-- SessionInbox: pending user/synthetic inputs and compaction/move barriers
|   |-- Per-session serialized reconcile/admit/cancel/steer/queue
|   |   `-- -> Bus events -> SessionProjector -> inbox rows
|   `-- nextPromotable/promote -> visible input at runner boundaries
|       |-- steer eligible between steps
|       `-- queue eligible at next input/idle boundary
|-- InstructionEntry / InstructionState: durable session guidance
|-- SessionHistory helpers: decode active transcript and instruction/model changes
|   `-- -> message rows; honor revert and compaction boundaries
`-- SessionTransfer / SessionStats helpers
    `-- Import/export -> Session/Bus; usage queries -> projected SQL rows

|-- Model / Provider / AISDK: catalogs and provider adapters
|   `-- ModelResolver -> provider route + shared Credential -> resolved model
|-- Agent / Skill / Reference / instruction-source services

SessionExecution: host-owned execution machinery
[session/execution.ts; session/run-coordinator.ts; session/execution/subagent-report.ts]
|
|-- SessionRunCoordinator (constructed in SessionExecution's scope)
|   |-- Scoped FiberSet runtime
|   |-- executions: Map<SessionID, Execution>
|   |   `-- Execution: one process-local busy period per session
|   |       |-- owner fiber + done Deferred for joiners
|   |       |-- scope + pendingWake: coalesced input/steer doorbell
|   |       `-- stopping + interruptionReason
|   |-- Operations over that map
|   |   |-- run: start or join; stopping execution -> await then run fresh
|   |   |-- wake: start or ring doorbell; input scope subsumes steer
|   |   |-- interrupt: clear old wakes; acknowledge before cleanup completes
|   |   `-- settle: resolve joiners; late wake starts successor; awaitIdle rechecks
|   `-- Captured lifecycle callbacks
|       |-- started -> Bus.Execution.Started + Store.claim in one transaction
|       |   `-- -> report.started: bind startedSeq and current Job generation
|       |-- drain(sessionID): reload -> Store; borrow -> Instance.provide(session)
|       |   |-- -> SessionRunner.drain (location peer, not owned here)
|       |   `-- Moved/Reloaded -> reload placement and reacquire graph; carry continuation
|       `-- settled: one terminal observation per busy period
|           |-- Shutdown interruption -> publish Interrupted; preserve claim and running Job
|           `-- Other outcomes -> report.prepare -> Bus terminal with settlement.commit
|               `-- After commit -> settlement.deliver (best effort; outbox survives failure)
`-- SubagentReport coordinator
    |-- periods: Map<SessionID, {startedSeq, boundGeneration}>
    |-- prepare: consume period -> Job.prepareSubagentReport
    |   `-- Settlement closure
    |       |-- commit -> Store.release + Job report outbox in terminal transaction
    |       `-- deliver -> parent Inbox synthetic steer input; acknowledge via Job
    |           `-- -> coordinator.wake(parent), unless reverted or missing
    `-- Uses shared Store/Job/Inbox; owns no durable tables or Job fibers

SessionRunnerLLM: one service per cached location graph
[session/runner/{llm,step,publish-llm-event,retry}.ts]
|
|-- titles: scoped FiberMap<SessionID, fiber>
|   `-- Visible input for untitled root -> SessionTitle.generate; only if missing
|-- drain operation: per-call turn state (step, force, continuation, promotable)
|   |-- -> Plugin.awaitActivation; then settle stale compactions and tool calls
|   `-- advanceToStep boundary
|       |-- Closed location -> transport.close -> return Reloaded to Execution
|       |-- -> Inbox controls: manual compaction or move; move returns Moved
|       `-- -> Context.select / InstructionState.prepare -> Inbox.promote -> Context.load
|-- runStep: per-call logical-step policy (called by drain)
|   |-- State: assistantMessageID, initial context, recovery flags, retryAttempt
|   |-- SessionRunnerRetry helper: decision policy + wait operation
|   |   `-- -> retry hook / Bus.RetryScheduled; delay before retry
|   |-- -> Context/request + Compaction: auto, precompute, overflow recovery
|   |-- Prepared request value: request/options/retry/executeTool closure
|   |   |-- Max steps -> toolChoice=none; retry refreshes without promoting input
|   |   `-- Wrap executeTool with Plugin.awaitActivation; keep captured snapshot
|   `-- -> captured SessionStep.attempt; interpret outcome and continue/retry/compact
`-- SessionStep helper (captured once; not a service or execution loop)
    |-- Captured references -> Bus, LLMClient, Snapshot, ToolOutput
    `-- attempt: scoped per-invocation resources [detail: runner-attempt]
        |-- Start-snapshot fiber, provider consumer and local tool-run records
        |-- LLM event publisher [detail: runner-publisher]
        |   `-- Owns step/tool facts and fragment buffers, not tool executions
        `-- Settlement joins/cancels tools; returns outcome to runStep

SessionStep.attempt: resources of one scoped invocation
[packages/core/src/session/runner/step.ts]
|
|-- Input: prepared request + caller-owned policy callbacks
|   `-- -> runner retry/overflow policy, lifecycle and interruption probes
|-- pendingStartSnapshot: scoped Snapshot.capture fiber
|   `-- Overlaps provider request; joined before first event/local tool dispatch
|-- publisher: per-attempt createLLMEventPublisher [detail: runner-publisher]
|   `-- -> publish/progress/toolExecution/record; does not execute tools
|-- providerStream: LLMClient.stream(request, options) consumer
|   |-- Before fork: -> publisher.publish(event), including Tool.Called
|   |-- Provider-hosted calls stay in stream; only local calls enter toolRuns
|   `-- Drain to stream end; always -> publisher.flush
|-- toolRuns: array of local call records
|   `-- Each record
|       |-- ToolCall + scoped execution fiber
|       |   |-- -> prepared.executeTool (runner activation gate + captured snapshot)
|       |   `-- -> ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher.toolExecution; Tool.Error -> failTool
|       `-- Cancel object: listener count, cancelled flag and Deferred gate
|           `-- Passed to executor; trigger reports whether a listener can stop itself
`-- Settlement: uninterruptible bookkeeping around interruptible work
    |-- -> publisher.streamed after provider exit, before joining local tools
    |-- Join tool fibers; stop on interruption; classify exits after all end
    |   `-- User stop: signal listeners; interrupt others; five-second grace then interrupt
    |-- Non-user daemon handoff interrupt, no declines -> leave step/calls unsettled
    |-- Before visible output: may return Compacted/RecoverFull/Retry without terminal
    |-- -> publisher: settle declines, failed/missing/incomplete calls and assistant failure
    |-- Recorded finish/failure -> Snapshot.capture/files + SessionUsage.record
    |   `-- -> Bus.Step.Ended or publisher.publishStepFailure with usage/snapshot/files
    `-- Outcome -> runStep: Completed/Retry/RecoverFull/Compacted/OutputLimit; or failure

LLM event publisher: per-attempt closure, not a service or tool scheduler
[packages/core/src/session/runner/publish-llm-event.ts]
|
|-- Captured input: Bus.publish reference, session/assistant IDs, model, start snapshot
|-- Step facts
|   |-- started / firstTokenPublished / outputStarted / providerFailed flags
|   |-- failure + finish record (reason, native metadata, raw usage)
|   `-- record(): immutable StepRecord view -> attempt recovery and settlement
|-- tools: Map<callID, ToolState>
|   `-- Each tool fact
|       |-- name, called, settled, providerExecuted and progress metadata
|       `-- Bounded input excerpt (2048 chars + full length) and malformed flag
|-- Fragment accumulators: text, reasoning and tool input
|   |-- Each: chunks map + nextOrdinal counter
|   |   `-- Fragment: ordinal, value chunks, pending delta, native metadata, timer handle
|   |-- Text/reasoning: single open block each; deltas batched at 100 ms
|   |   `-- Timer fibers are children of provider fiber; handles live in fragments
|   `-- End/flush: stop timers, publish pending deltas and Ended events, remove chunks
`-- Publication methods (called by provider loop, tool fibers and attempt settlement)
    |-- publish(event): uninterruptible writes; synchronous check-and-mark state
    |   |-- Start/first token/text/reasoning/tool input/call/result -> Bus events
    |   `-- step-finish: record finish/usage; does not publish Step.Ended
    |-- progress/toolExecution/failTool -> Bus.Tool.Progress/Success/Failed
    |-- flush/failIncompleteTools -> close fragments and classify incomplete inputs
    |-- startAssistant -> await start snapshot -> Bus.Step.Started
    |-- streamed/publishStepFailure -> Bus.Step.Streamed/Failed
    `-- No shared writer queue: per-source order; consumers fold by ID/ordinal
